title: v1 chat output schema negotiator: stop-signal fallback and weighted logprob enrichment
author: Anika Patel
description: Motivation: Customers expect /v1/chat.completions parity while we maintain runtime stability and improved structured tool output. This PR introduces a negotiator layer that canonicalizes incoming v1 chat params (stop, roles, max_tokens, temperature) into our internal representation while providing a graceful fallback path for stop signals and enriched logprob metadata for downstream evaluators. Key changes: 1) parameter translation + role aliasing table with deterministic precedence, 2) explicit stop-signal fallback that converts stop arrays into weighted sentinel priorities (helps streaming cutover), 3) logprob enrichment when model/kernel can't return token logprobs (best-effort synthetic scores + provenance tag), 4) framed JSON output envelope for function/tool results to prevent stream deserialization ambiguity, 5) small changes to stream heartbeat and backpressure to surface partial toolcall boundaries. Implementation notes: negotiation is implemented as an in-process translator (service/api/chatv1/param_translator.py) used by the v1 adapter; streaming boundaries are coordinated by runtime/stream/coordinator.go with a new 'sentinel_weight' hint in request metadata; envelope schema is opt-in behind config flag "chatv1_envelope_v2" to allow staged rollouts. Tests & rollout: unit tests added for role aliasing, stop-weighting heuristics, and envelope parsing; integration test simulating toolcall fragmentation included in perf-canary harness; staged rollout via canary config in console. Checklist: - [x] param translation implemented - [x] streaming boundary tests - [x] CI green after flakiness fixes - [x] docs updated in redwood-docs/examples - [x] feature flag gated for canary - [x] Linked Linear ENG-4211 for rollout coordination Links: Linear/ENG-4211 | RFC: docs/rfcs/chatv1-output-negotiator.md | related PRs: redwood-sdk-python#412, redwood-sdk-typescript#387

review_comments: Marcus Lee: Please clarify ownership of sentinel_weight metadata—should it be part of request.targetHints?
Author (Anika Patel): Moved sentinel_weight into request.metadata.sentinels per Marcus suggestion, updated coordinator.go accordingly.
Sofia Alvarez: Good catch on envelope demarcation — unit tests cover fragmented fncall across two stream packets but add an assert for extra bytes after envelope end.
Author (Anika Patel): Added the assert and a comment in envelope_parser.go explaining tolerant trailing whitespace handling.
Daniel Kim: Can we avoid synthetic logprobs for production unless explicitly enabled? Risk of metric pollution.
Author (Anika Patel): Synthetic enrichment is guarded behind config flag 'logprob_enrich_policy=best_effort' and emits provenance='synthetic' to allow filtering in analytics. Added release note.
CI: build/linux-tests flake detected on streaming suite, reran and passed (flaky:h2-streaming-interop).
SRE (approval): load test in perf-canary shows <5% p50 latency increase with envelope enabled; recommend canary rollout.
release_notes: Add chatv1 parameter negotiator that normalizes stop/role/params for v1 parity; introduces framed JSON envelope for safer tool/function outputs over streaming; opt-in canary and config flags for staged rollout; synthetic logprob enrichment behind feature flag; no breaking changes by default.
